title: MGIT Hyderabad Celebrates Fifth Consecutive Year in Top 100 of NPTEL Rankings with 'A' Grade Achievement - MGIT

## MGIT Hyderabad Celebrates Fifth Consecutive Year in Top 100 of NPTEL Rankings with ‘A’ Grade Achievement

News Date : 22 Jan 2024News ReportMahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) in Hyderabad has achieved a significant milestone by being ranked in the top 100 institutions for the fifth consecutive year in the SWAYAM-NPTEL Local Chapter ratings. This year, for the period July to December 2023, MGIT has also received an ‘A’ grade.The NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning) is a key initiative by the Indian government for online learning. MGIT’s consistent top 100 ranking over the past five years highlights its commitment to quality education and technology.This achievement reflects the hard work of MGIT’s faculty and students. The institute is recognized for its high-quality technical education and is committed to maintaining this standard in the future.MGIT’s management, students, and alumni are proud of this accomplishment, which underscores the institute’s role as a leader in technical education in India.
